The machine-generated description omits this clear statement of purpose, instead describing it generically as 'durchschnittliche prozentuale Wachstumsraten'.

The chart shows static average percentages for each decade, not growth rates. The machine-generated description introduces an interpretive term not present in the figure or reference.

The reference description mentions the exact positioning of value labels ('oberhalb bzw. unterhalb der Balkenenden'), which the machine-generated description includes, but the reference also notes the absence of visual emphasis ('keine besondere visuelle Hervorhebung'). The machine-generated description does mention this, but it is phrased as an observation ('es ist keine besondere visuelle Hervorhebung... erkennbar') rather than a direct description of the visual feature.
